stem:
Kavya compares a green leaf and a non-green root. Both are living plant parts. She asks what substances take part when the plant respires to release energy.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: In all living parts, glucose reacts with oxygen to release carbon dioxide, water, and energy.
Glucose reacts with nitrogen instead of oxygen in every plant part.
Only green leaves respire; non-green roots do not.
Respiration releases energy without using oxygen in ordinary plant cells.

teacher.key_rationale: Plant respiration uses glucose and oxygen in all living parts, including roots, and releases carbon dioxide, water, and energy.
